title: Contraction
explanation: Use an apostrophe in the negative contraction 'wouldn't'.

title: Present Simple
wrong: She go to the office every day.
correct: She goes to the office every day.
explanation: He/She/It takes V1+s/es in the Present Simple.

title: Auxiliary
explanation: Use doesn't with a third-person singular subject.

title: Common learner error
explanation: Agree is a main verb, so 'am' is not needed.

title: Past Simple
wrong: Yesterday I go to the office.
correct: Yesterday I went to the office.
explanation: A completed past-time marker such as yesterday normally calls for V2.

title: Present Perfect
correct: I have already sent the email.
explanation: Present Perfect uses have/has + V3 for a completed action connected with the present.

title: Adjective
explanation: An adjective complement normally needs a form of be.
